text:
maria: Quick sync on the Orion Enterprise POC — delivery checklist and owners. Kickoff next Monday, target 3-week trial window.

raj: Thanks — can we lock success criteria now so SE can demo reliable metrics?

maria: Proposed success criteria: 1) API integration done and ingesting sample data, 2) p95 latency <= 250ms on staging for typical 512-token calls, 3) embeddings parity within 2% of baseline for search use-case, 4) SSO + audit logs validated.

carmen: I can own the integration API and model pinning. Timeline: initial wire up by Fri, end-to-end test by next Wed. Need staging creds and sample dataset.

evan: I can provision staging GPU and networking, but need DNS and TLS cert request from you. Also, does this need private subnet access?

maria: Yes, staging should mirror their VPC -> private subnet. I'll share connection details. Who handles certs?

evan: We handle certs once we get CSR + SAN list. Send to infra@redwood and we'll queue. ETA 24-48h after request.

raj: For the sample dataset: please strip PII and drop into s3://redwood-poc-orion/sample-v1/ and send presigned link. We'll run evals.

maria: Will do. ETA for dataset upload is tomorrow EOD.

ben: Product note — add a canary policy to the rollout: route 10% traffic to quantized variant, 90% to baseline. If quality drop >1.5% rollback. Carmen, can you set that in the rollout config?

carmen: Yep — I'll add a rollout rule and tag model versions. Also need a quick smoke test script. Raj, can you share the eval prompts you want?

raj: Putting them here: [short QA set], [search query set], [multiturn chat set]. I'll paste a trimmed sample in a sec.

maria: Action items recap: 
- maria: send VPC peering details + SAN list for certs (today)
- evan: provision staging GPU pool + private subnet (after cert request)
- carmen: implement integration endpoints, rollout rule, smoke test (wire up by Fri)
- raj: upload eval prompt sets and run parity checks once staging up
- ben: confirm success thresholds and monitoring dashboard fields

carmen: Quick question — what is the expected peak qps for the POC?

maria: They expect up to 25 QPS burst, sustained ~5 QPS. Should be fine for a single c5g-style node, but adjust if p95 slacks.

evan: Noted. I'll size for 50 QPS buffer.

raj: Sample curl to validate endpoint (use staging token):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.orion.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize the following...","max_tokens":256}'
```

maria: Perfect. Please confirm by EOD if owners can hit their wire-up dates. If any blocker, flag here and we'll escalate to infra/solutions lead. :thumbsup:

carmen: Confirmed — aiming for Fri for initial wire-up.

evan: Confirmed — cert request once I get SAN list, provisioning starts.

raj: Confirmed — will upload prompts tomorrow morning and run first pass Thursday.

ben: I'll set up the dashboard widgets and alert thresholds by Wednesday.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: infra/provision-staging -> started (task id: d4fe3b). ETA ~18m.

maria: Great, thanks everyone. I'll DM the SAN list and S3 path. Will update this thread when dataset is uploaded.
